title: Budget Billing Plan Terms on Withdrawal, Service Closure and Moving
content:
# Budget Billing Plan Terms on Withdrawal, Service Closure and Moving

Each Budget Billing plan states when a customer's withdrawal takes effect, how the deferred balance is settled on withdrawal and on the closing of the service agreement, how long a withdrawal bars enrolling in the same plan again, and whether the plan moves with the customer to a new service agreement.

## Withdrawal

| Plan | When a voluntary withdrawal takes effect | Settlement of the deferred balance on withdrawal | Months after a voluntary withdrawal before the customer may enroll in the same plan again |
|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | The next regular bill after the request | Deferred balance billed or credited on the next regular bill | 0 |
| Residential Budget Billing Plan | The next regular bill after the request | Deferred balance billed or credited on the next regular bill | 0 |
| Residential FlatBill Plan | The next regular bill after the request | Actual charges of the term to date less FlatBill amounts billed, billed or credited on the next regular bill | 12 |
| Commercial Levelized Billing Plan | The next regular bill after the request | Deferred balance billed or credited on the next regular bill | 0 |
| Commercial Budget Billing Plan | The next regular bill after the request | Deferred balance billed or credited on the next regular bill | 0 |
| Small Business FlatBill Plan | The next regular bill after the request | Actual charges of the term to date less FlatBill amounts billed, billed or credited on the next regular bill | 12 |

## Service closure and moving

| Plan | Settlement of the deferred balance when the service agreement closes | Plan moves with the customer to a new service agreement |
|---|---|---|
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | Deferred balance billed or credited on the final bill | Yes |
| Residential Budget Billing Plan | Deferred balance billed or credited on the final bill | Yes |
| Residential FlatBill Plan | Actual charges of the term to date less FlatBill amounts billed, billed or credited on the final bill | No |
| Commercial Levelized Billing Plan | Deferred balance billed or credited on the final bill | No |
| Commercial Budget Billing Plan | Deferred balance billed or credited on the final bill | No |
| Small Business FlatBill Plan | Actual charges of the term to date less FlatBill amounts billed, billed or credited on the final bill | No |

## Reading the terms

- A withdrawal lockout of 0 months means that a customer who withdrew from that plan may enroll in the same plan again without waiting. On the two FlatBill plans, a customer who withdrew may not enroll in the same plan again until 12 months after the withdrawal.
- Only the Residential Levelized Billing Plan and the Residential Budget Billing Plan move with the customer to a new service agreement. The two commercial plans and the two FlatBill plans do not.
- A withdrawal settlement is carried on the next regular bill; a closure settlement is carried on the final bill of the closing agreement.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A customer on the Residential FlatBill Plan withdraws; the withdrawal takes effect on the next regular bill. If the customer asks to return to the Residential FlatBill Plan 7 months after the withdrawal, the 12-month period has not run and the enrollment is not open to the customer. A customer who withdrew from the Residential Budget Billing Plan may return to that plan at once.
- A Commercial Budget Billing Plan customer closes service at one site and opens service at another: the plan does not move, and the deferred balance of the closing agreement is billed or credited on its final bill.
